name: list_agent_templates
description: List public AI agent templates published on 50agents.com. Use when discovering or browsing template names, descriptions, and categories before sign-up; do not use to create workspaces or change user data. Returns MCP text content whose body is JSON from GET /api/plugins (paginated plugin rows for the requested limit, page, and optional category filter).

limit.description: Maximum templates per page as an integer from 1 to 100. Example: 20.

page.description: 1-based page index as a positive integer. Example: 1 for the first page, 2 for the next.

category.description: Optional category slug filter (lowercase ASCII string). Example: "sales". Omit to include every category.
